positions.name: PallasineChecklistAsAuthoritativeArtifact
positions.frame: what document governs new-hire onboarding, and how did it come to hold that status?
positions.why: Both expressions concern the Pallasine checklist as the onboarding artifact of record: src-1 states its current mandatory use (present, authority-ranking, legitimate power, decision-grade conviction), while src-2 supplies its provenance — that it superseded the prior wiki page last quarter (past, informational, claim-level conviction). Read together, the pair traces the checklist's standing from historical replacement to present-day mandate; the conviction gradient (decision vs. claim) is held in tension rather than resolved, since one establishes the rule and the other merely dates its arrival.
